vector_source.project: Hanzi Writer / Make Me a Hanzi

policy: Vector availability and stroke-count compatibility are material-readiness checks only. They do not grant artwork_ready; each target still requires comparison against its reviewed normative stroke/shape evidence and cumulative-stroke visual review.
limits: Third-party vector JSON files remain temporary review material and are not committed as normative evidence.
This audit does not validate glyph outline identity, terminal details, positional variants, page layout, PDF, manifest, or release eligibility.
